subject: Coffee's Metabolic Edge: Less Fat, More Muscle, and a Hormonal Signature
script: From Agewell Brief: Coffee's Metabolic Edge: Less Fat, More Muscle, and a Hormonal Signature. A Finnish cohort study reveals that habitual coffee drinkers carry less visceral fat, more skeletal muscle, and distinct sex-hormone profiles—hints at a deeper metabolic tuning that echoes biophysical principles of cellular efficiency. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
